description: Every set \(X\) of infinite cardinality \(\kappa\) is a union of \(\operatorname{cf}(\kappa)\) many subsets of \(X\), each of cardinality less than \(\kappa\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.cofinal_cover.{u} {α : Type u} (X : Set α) (κ : Cardinal.{u})
  (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) (hX : Cardinal.mk ↑X = κ) :
  ∃ pieces, (∀ (i : κ.ord.cof.ord.ToType), pieces i ⊆ X ∧ Cardinal.mk ↑(pieces i) < κ) ∧ ⋃ i, pieces i = X
